title: pluchea baccharis
intro: Pluchea baccharis, commonly known as "Baccharis" or "Eucalipto Mole", is a plant species in the Asteraceae family, native to tropical and subtropical regions of the Americas. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Pluchea baccharis include its ability to reduce fever, relieve coughs, and soothe digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of Pluchea baccharis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
